description: WiSense StateMessage v1 contract fixtures and expected parse results across runtimes

asymmetry_notes.missing_schema_version: Python from_dict defaults schema_version to 1 if absent; Unreal strictly requires schema_version == 1
asymmetry_notes.unsupported_schema_version: Python allows schema_version >= 1 without checking == 1; Unreal strictly enforces schema_version == 1
asymmetry_notes.zone_as_string: Python int(data['zone_id']) coerces string digits to int; Unreal rejects non-numeric types
asymmetry_notes.zone_fractional: Python int(data['zone_id']) truncates float 2.5 to int 2; Unreal rejects non-integer numbers

fixtures.name: active_zone
fixtures.description: Valid state with active motion and confident zone assignment

fixtures.name: ambiguous_motion
fixtures.description: Valid active motion where zone is ambiguous (zone_id and margin null)

fixtures.name: presence_hold
fixtures.description: Valid quiet period during presence timeout hold (motion false, presence true)

fixtures.name: quiet
fixtures.description: Valid completely idle state (motion false, presence false)

fixtures.name: legacy_occupied_format
fixtures.description: Legacy prototype format lacking schema_version, timestamp, and distinct motion flags

fixtures.name: zone_as_string
fixtures.description: Zone ID encoded as string rather than integer

fixtures.name: zone_zero
fixtures.description: Invalid non-positive zone ID (zones are 1-indexed, zone_id >= 1)

fixtures.name: zone_fractional
fixtures.description: Invalid fractional zone ID (must be an integer)

fixtures.name: motion_false_with_zone
fixtures.description: Motion gating violation: zone_id must be null when is_motion is false
